metrics.primary: Maximum sustainable offered rate satisfying frozen TTFT, E2E, ITL and quality SLOs without growing backlog; compare SLO-qualified goodput per GPU dollar.
metrics.cost: At the scenario of eight GPUs at $4.50/GPU-hour, cost per million SLO-qualified requests = 10000 / good_requests_per_second. Cost per million qualified output tokens = 10000 / good_output_tokens_per_second. This is a scenario, not a cloud bill.

experiments.slo_contract: Import exact scorer predicates andthresholds from baseline score/manifest artifacts before execution. Preserve both AIPerf andcustom scorer outputs. Predeclare chosen primary; do not tune after seeing results.
correctness: Preserve exact rejection sampling and verification semantics; do not relax token acceptance for throughput.
Greedy token equivalence on matched prompts covering mixed prefills, rollback, EOS and batch drain; any mismatch blocks advancement until understood.
Sampling distribution checks on controlled logits plus task-quality noninferiority with a frozen tolerance. Task accuracy alone does not prove distribution preservation.
Exercise DP rank divergence, cancellation, batch drain and long contexts. Illegal memory access or hang is a failure, not an outlier to remove.

sequential_budget.inspection: 30 CPU minutes for source/config audit; no GPU needed.
sequential_budget.screen: Up to 12 cells, each 2 minutes measurement plus 1 minute warmup; stop obvious regression. Maximum 60 node-minutes including a 10-minute stress test.
sequential_budget.confirm: Two finalists only; three paired AB/BA repeats per selected held-out trace/rate, frozen before results. Maximum 90 node-minutes including startup. Total cap 150 node-minutes = 20 GPU-hours per candidate. Record a new plan before extending.
sequential_budget.stop: Stop on correctness failure, baseline mismatch, sustained queue growth, or >10% tail regression. Preserve logs and scope.

decision_rules.support: Design choice: at least 5% SLO-capacity goodput improvement over the strongest matched static control, with paired 95% CI lower bound above zero and all guards met. At fixed offered load, use at least 5% p95 latency reduction with noninferior goodput. These thresholds are proposed, not predicted gains.
decision_rules.reject: Correctness/safety violation; or confirmation CI upper bound excludes meaningful 5% benefit throughout target regimes; or >5% p95 guard regression. Distinguish mechanism failure from deployment inapplicability.
decision_rules.inconclusive: CI spans the decision threshold; baseline cannot be pinned; scorer disagreement changes ranking; unstable load; bottleneck not observable; or budget exhausted.
